task: Replace the SDK's per-push Jev REV gate with REV's deterministic tests gate.

criteria.description: scripts/rev-evidence.mjs and scripts/rev-evidence.test.mjs are deleted, .rev/ contains only README.md, contract.json, run-tests.mjs, task.json and tests-gate.test.mjs, and the tests CI job no longer runs any REV evidence step.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > deletes the old evidence collector and leaves only the new gate files in .rev

criteria.description: No GitHub workflow file references a TypeSafe API key, the TypeSafe endpoint, an api-key input or the rev-evidence job.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > no workflow references TypeSafe, an api-key input or the rev-evidence job

criteria.description: The REV job uses aviarytech/rev pinned to a full 40-character commit SHA with scope: tests, and the rev-tests job checks out aviarytech/rev at that same commit.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > REV job uses aviarytech/rev pinned to a full SHA in tests scope, and rev-tests checks out the same commit

criteria.description: The REV job needs every other CI job and runs for pull requests unless cancelled. The contract's requiredChecks are exactly those other jobs.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > REV job needs every other CI job, which are exactly the contract required checks

criteria.description: The REV job's only steps download the input artifact, run REV and upload the report. It has no run step and references no secret or API key, and it reads the contract digest from the REV_CONTRACT_PR_<pull request number> repository variable.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > REV job only downloads inputs, runs REV and uploads the report, with the PR contract variable and no secret

criteria.description: The rev-tests job checks out the PR head with full history and without persisted credentials, and under set -euo pipefail runs, in order: tests-change.js to collect the change, git merge-base, run-tests.mjs on head sources, git worktree add of the merge base, and run-tests.mjs on that worktree with head tests.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > rev-tests runs the named tests on head sources and on a merge-base worktree

criteria.description: run-tests.mjs runs .test.ts files under Bun from the nearest directory containing package.json (the repository root if none closer), runs .test.mjs and .test.js files under Node from the repository root, and rejects any other file.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > chooses Bun from the nearest package directory for TypeScript and Node from the root for JavaScript

criteria.description: run-tests.mjs copies the head's named test files onto the base sources and writes a report carrying the given source and tests SHAs and repository-relative test IDs. Passing head tests are reported passed. On base, a failing test is reported failed and a test file that cannot load yields no passing entry, without aborting the run.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > reports head passes and base failures, copying head tests onto base without aborting

criteria.description: The REV guide shows the tests-change.js command as BASE_SHA HEAD_SHA .rev/contract.json .rev/task.json OUTPUT and the review-contract.js command as .rev/task.json CHANGE --pin onionoriginals/sdk PR_NUMBER with TYPESAFE_API_KEY set, and documents omitting --pin for a dry run.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > REV guide shows the collect and review commands in the order the scripts accept

criteria.description: The REV guide shows a version 2 task with tests and paths, names the REV_CONTRACT_PR_<number> variable, says Jev never runs per push, and says changing a named test file causes contract-mismatch.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > REV guide explains criteria, digest pinning and that Jev never runs per push

criteria.description: The workflow README says the REV gate runs in tests scope with no API key and that Jev reviews each PR's contract once, and links the REV guide. The PR template checklist covers .rev/task.json, path globs, tests that fail without the change, review-contract.js and REV_CONTRACT_PR_<number>, and links the guide.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > workflow README and PR template describe the gate and link the guide

criteria.description: The PR adds an empty changeset, so no package release is produced.
tests: .rev/tests-gate.test.mjs > REV tests gate > adds an empty changeset so no package is released
